verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs describe Serverless as pay-per-second GPU workers billed only while a worker runs. Flex workers explicitly 'scale to zero when idle', and FlashBoot or model caching reduce cold starts. Developers can deploy their own code with Flash (project templates include GPU workers) and manage Serverless endpoints via the CLI and SDKs. missing for 10: detailed documentation of autoscaling mechanics (scaling triggers, max-worker configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of serverless scale-to-zero behavior.
